1parado/zhishi.description: Browser extension for managing webpage usage time
1parado/zhishi.body:
# Zhishi · Attention & Health

A quiet, restrained Chrome / Edge extension: it records usage time for each website and provides eye-care and sedentary-break reminders, website limits, and focus mode. **All data is stored only on your local machine** and is never uploaded to any server.

The visual system is ported from [@paradox/ui](https://github.com/1parado/UI_UI) (shadcn token system, light and dark themes).

## Interface overview

**Overview**: today / last 7 days statistics, three switchable charts, website ranking, and an annual heatmap (hover for details, click to open the timeline).

**Website ranking**: switchable between today / last 7 days, sorted by usage time or visit count. The top 7 are shown by default, and “View more” expands the full list. Each row **only shows the current sort basis** (time when sorted by time, count when sorted by count), while the other metric keeps being recorded in the background. **Merge by root domain** is on by default, so `linux.do` and `cdk.linux.do` are combined into one row. Turn it off to return to the full subdomain breakdown. Click any row to open that site (if it is already open, switches to it).

**Website limits**: set a daily cap per domain. When the cap is exceeded, the site redirects to a block page. Supports search, filtering, and time-slot blocking. Video heartbeat sites are also managed on this page.

**Allowlist (focus mode)**: sites on the allowlist are accessible, and all others are blocked. Besides manual entry and right-click adding, you can **add from currently open tabs**. This lists all open web pages at once (multiple tabs on the same domain are merged and counted automatically). Check the ones you want and add them in one click. Single and batch additions use the same checkbox path, so checking one row adds just one.

**Health reminders**: 20-20-20 eye care and sedentary reminders. The interval and reminder hours are adjustable, and there are no interruptions when you are not at the computer.

**Data**: CSV / JSON export and one-click clearing of all records.

**Settings**: Chinese and English bilingual interface, light / dark / follow-system theme, and a daily goal.

## Features

- **Usage time statistics**: counts only the time when “tab active + browser in foreground + system not idle”. Settlement is event-driven, written to disk every minute, and accurate to the second.
- **Visit count statistics**: each time you “start staying on a site” counts once. Switching to another site and back counts as a new visit, but switching back after the window loses focus does not. Time and count are **always recorded together**. The ranking only switches which one is displayed (sorting by count shows only count, sorting by time shows only time).
- **Merge by root domain**: the website ranking, timeline legend, popup ranking, and share card can all switch between “merge to root domain” and “full subdomain breakdown” (merged by default). `linux.do` and `cdk.linux.do` are counted as the same site. This only changes the display-layer aggregation. The underlying data is always recorded by full domain.
- **Video heartbeat**: on allowlisted sites, timing continues while audio or video plays (works in fullscreen, picture-in-picture, and background). Can be toggled via right-click.
- **Reading heartbeat**: wheel and touch scrolling count as the user being present, so scrolling through long articles is no longer mistaken for leaving.
- **Eye-care / sedentary reminders**: interval and reminder hours are customizable. The badge shows today's cumulative total in real time.
- **Website limits**: daily cap, over-limit block page, and time-slot blocking. Users can “allow 10…

# GsCore Frontend / gsuid_hub v0.3.0

The web console frontend project for GsCore. This project provides [gsuid_core](https://github.com/Genshin-bots/gsuid_core) with a modern, responsive, internationalized web management console for managing core configuration, plugins, logs, databases, AI capabilities, and runtime status.

- Backend project: [gsuid_core](https://github.com/Genshin-bots/gsuid_core) 💖 One set of business logic, multi-platform support!
- Frontend project: [gsuid_hub](https://github.com/Genshin-bots/gsuid_hub) 💖 An easy-to-use web console that controls everything!
- Detailed documentation: [docs.sayu-bot.com](https://docs.sayu-bot.com) ([Quick Start](https://docs.sayu-bot.com/Started/InstallCore.html) | [Web Console](https://docs.sayu-bot.com/Started/WebConsole.html) | [Plugin Market](https://docs.sayu-bot.com/InstallPlugins/PluginsList.html))

## Project Overview

`gsuid_hub` is a single-page application built with Vite + React + TypeScript. It uses a Hash Router to suit backend mounting scenarios. In production, the default base path is `/app/`. In development, Vite's proxy connects to the local backend at `http://localhost:8765`.

Modules are divided into five areas by responsibility:

| Module | Scope | Main Pages |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Overview & Data** | System/Bot runtime overview, metric trends, data table browsing | `/home`, `/dashboard`, `/database` |
| **Configuration Management** | Core / Framework / Database / State Store / Group Profile | `/core-config`, `/framework-config`, `/state-store`, `/group-profile` |
| **Plugin Ecosystem** | Local plugins, plugin store, install/update/uninstall, Git mirroring and updates; unified plugin ICON component | `/plugins`, `/plugin-store`, `/git-update` |
| **AI Capabilities** | Providers and models, personas, MCP, capability proxies, tools/skills/knowledge/memory/emoji, scheduled tasks, dashboards, approvals, budgets, statistics, Artifacts, tool persistence, session and runtime logs, operations diagnostics and debugging | … |

L4Ph/Novelty.body:
# Novelty

**Modern, simple, and transparent.**

A cross-platform novel viewer built with Flutter, redesigned from scratch for reading works from 小説家になろう and カクヨム.

## Overview

Novelty is a client application that supports **小説家になろう and カクヨム**, developed to deliver the best reading experience.
Based on an **offline-first** design philosophy, you can keep reading smoothly from your saved library even in unstable network conditions or out of coverage.

A site abstraction layer (`NovelSource` / `NovelSite`) lets you use なろう and カクヨム with the same operating feel, and it is prepared for adding future providers ([docs/architecture/multi_provider.md](https://github.com/L4Ph/Novelty/blob/HEAD/docs/architecture/multi_provider.md)).

While pursuing simplicity that strips away complex requirements and features so you can focus on reading, it provides the essential functions expected of modern reading styles.

## Key Features

### Pursuit of the Reading Experience
*   **Full support for vertical and horizontal writing**: Supports vertical text display, which is ideal for Japanese novels. You can also instantly switch to horizontal writing to suit your preference.
*   **Detailed customization**: Freely adjust font size, font type, line spacing, and more to build your own optimal reading environment.

### Comfortable Work Discovery
*   **Ranking feature**: Supports **provider switching** between なろう and カクヨム. Easily find popular works by each site's ranking type (daily, weekly, monthly, etc.).
*   **Advanced search**: Search works with detailed conditions such as keyword, genre, character count, and completion status (なろう). カクヨム supports keyword search.

### Library and Data Management
*   **Offline reading**: Thanks to thorough offline-first design, once you download a work you can enjoy reading anytime, anywhere, regardless of connection.
*   **Automatic reading history sync**: Reading progress is recorded automatically, so you never forget where you left off.
*   **Backup and restore**: Export and import your library and history data as files, so you're covered when changing devices.

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2

# Intelligent Cockpit Multi-Agent System · Cockpit Agent

> A cloud-edge collaborative AI agent system for intelligent cockpits. Say '小舟小舟' and everything from millisecond-level vehicle control to multi-day trip planning and minute-level deep research is handled through one voice entry point. The cockpit screen is the HMI, and the phone is the Android companion app '小舟随行'. Two user clients share one backend brain, so the same person can keep chatting from inside the car and outside it. The LLM is only responsible for understanding and planning, and a deterministic system carries out execution. No vehicle control command is issued directly by the LLM.

The cockpit HMI and the Android '小舟随行' client share the backend. It includes T0 / T1 / T2, domain agents, real providers, voice, memory, vehicle manual and observability pipelines. **It is currently a Phase 1 engineering PoC**, and vehicle control is verified by a simulated VAL. For release and verification figures, see [QA/release handoff](https://github.com/SuperdeMan/cockpit-agent/blob/HEAD/docs/reviews/2026-08-30-qa-closeout-handoff.md). Historical sample results are not treated as a commitment to cover all scenarios.

The next direction has been consolidated into **v2 verifiable Agent Runtime + optional Jev semantic discrimination layer**. The plan is to first complete task/result contracts, trusted vehicle state and durable execution, and then add on-device bounded planning, real vehicle adaptation and integration pilots. The step business scope, server-side task/source references, ResultBundle and capability contracts already have a first implementation. # easy_simt

Design repository for easy_simt, a SIMT processor dedicated to the Golden kernel.

## Prerequisites

Three third-party dependencies (GPGPU-Sim, the nangate45 process library, and OpenRAM) are installed together in the repository's `third_party/` directory (contents are not committed; ignored by `.gitignore`):

```
source setup.sh
make deps              # install third-party dependencies
source setup.sh        # re-source; PDK_ROOT / GPGPU_SIM_ROOT / OPENRAM_HOME / OPENRAM_TECH now point inside the repository
```

Environment variable priority: manual export > in-repo `third_party/` > automatic detection of `~/pdk` (for compatibility with the old layout).

### GPGPU-Sim (external baseline comparison)

The repository's golden baseline data (SM7_TITANV configuration) and its cross-validation against the original configuration come from the GPGPU-Sim simulator. The main flow (model compilation, synthesis, regression) does not depend on it. The source is located at `third_party/gpgpu-sim` (fetched by `make deps`). Building requires the CUDA Toolkit; build it following its repository README, then enter the GPGPU-Sim mode environment (`GPGPU_SIM_ROOT` is exported by setup.sh). Note: CUDA programs run under GPGPU-Sim must be compiled with `nvcc -cudart shared`, because with a statically linked cudart the simulator cannot intercept runtime calls.

### Process library (nangate45)

Gate-level synthesis and timing comparison use the **nangate45** process library: the SI2 Nangate Open Cell Library (version `PDKv1.3_v2010_12.Apache.CCL`) with FreePDK45 design rules. It is distributed with the OpenROAD-flow-scripts repository and requires no license agreement. The standard cells have only one process corner (typical), no SDF, and no device model cards, so gate-level area and timing are only relative comparisons under the same basis, not sign-off evidence.

Library files are referenced via `$PDK_ROOT` (after `make deps` it points to `third_party/`; in the old layout, to `~/pdk`, where `nangate45` is a symlink to `orfs/flow/platforms/nangate45`). They are referenced, not copied or hand-edited, to keep a single source of truth. The figures in this section and in the subsequent flow scripts come from `orfs` HEAD `7ff3adf`.

Companion tools: the synthesis front end uses oss-cad-suite (a newer version of Yosys, including yosys-abc; the gate-level mapping commands are `dfflibmap` + `abc`). On the physical verification side, KLayout ≥…

You don't need Hancom Office. HWPX is a ZIP+XML (OWPML) format, so you can read, modify, and create files with pure Python alone — and it works on Windows, macOS, Linux, CI, and even **inside a ChatGPT chat with a Python environment**.

```text
Install the attached python_hwpx-*.whl with pip (pip install /mnt/data/python_hwpx-*.whl),

Everything from installation to the resulting file is completed within the conversation — you don't need Python on your own computer. chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.description: Hong Kong Immigration Department smart ID card appointment quota monitoring dashboard: detection every 5 minutes + email/Feishu release notifications (third-party tool, not official)
chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.body:
# HKID Appointment Quota Dashboard

Monitors the smart ID card appointment quotas at the six Hong Kong Immigration Department registration offices, checking roughly every 2 minutes, and notifies subscribers via email / Feishu group when slots are released. **A third-party public-interest tool, not an official Immigration Department service. It only monitors and sends alerts, and does not snatch or book appointments on anyone's behalf.**

## Dashboard entry

- **Preferred (stable direct access from mainland China):** https://hkid-quota-monitor.pages.dev/
- Backup: https://chen1111-a.github.io/hkid-quota-monitor/
  (access to github.io from mainland China is intermittent; jsDelivr/raw direct links carry a nosniff header and only display source code, so don't use them as web entry points)
- For the full experience in mainland China without a VPN, use **email subscription + Feishu group**. The notification path is entirely reachable directly within China, so releases reach your phone immediately; the dashboard is only a supplement

## How it works

```
cron-job.org (every 2 minutes) ──▶ GitHub Actions
                            │  python -m quota_monitor.run
                            │  ├─ fetch the Immigration Department's public quota API (read-only, one request per run)
                            │  ├─ diff against the previous snapshot → release events
                            │  └─ commit data/ + refresh jsDelivr cache
                            ▼
        index.html dashboard (mobile-first, auto-refreshes every 90 seconds)
        Email + Feishu notifications (triggered by release events, with debounce cooldown)
```

- API structure: [docs/api-notes.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/api-notes.md)
- 2-minute trigger configuration: [docs/cron-setup.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/cron-setup.md)

## Improvements over similar tools

- **Mobile-first:** dates scroll vertically by row, all 6 offices fit on one screen, no horizontal table dragging
- **Colorblind-friendly:** status cells use both color and text (available / few / full)
- **Notification anti-flood:** the official API has load-balancing data jitter (measured 304↔346 cells fluctuating within the same minute), so the notification layer applies a per-cell cooldown and doesn't alert on every round
- **Direct access in mainland China:** the email subscription and Feishu notification paths are fully reachable within China, no VPN needed
- Light and dark themes; summary cards directly answer “earliest date available to book”

# Japanese Programming Language "Nadesiko 3"

## What is "Nadesiko 3"

"Nadesiko 3" is a Japanese programming language. It is developed under the slogan "Easy programming for everyone."
Japanese programming languages are known for being easy to read and understand, so even first-time learners can enjoy learning to program.
For Japanese speakers, it is also ideal for programming education in their native language!
Also, Nadesiko was originally developed as a tool for business process improvement, so it excels at easily writing routine and batch processing tasks. It can be used for games, tools, and many other purposes.

- [Nadesiko Website](https://nadesi.com/)
- [Manual](https://nadesi.com/v3/doc/)

If you are trying Nadesiko for the first time, we recommend starting with the following tutorial. You can easily get a feel for the Japanese programming language.

## Supported Devices/Browsers

The web version of Nadesiko 3 is internally converted to JavaScript and executed. Therefore, it can run on the various devices where JavaScript works.

- Web browser (wnako3) - Supports major browsers (Chrome/Safari/Edge/Firefox) and runs on PC and smartphones
- Command line (cnako3) - Runs on the JavaScript execution engine "Node.js"

For details on the specific supported browsers, see [Supported Devices/Browsers](https://github.com/kujirahand/nadesiko3/blob/HEAD/doc/browsers.md). The supported Node.js version is v22 or later.

Also, separate from this repository, there is a PC version of Nadesiko 3 (implemented in the Go language).

- [PC version (gonako/gonako-gui)](https://github.com/kujirahand/nadesiko3go/) - You can develop desktop apps (gonako-gui) and command-line apps (gonako). Created apps can be packaged into a single executable file for easy distribution. It is an all-in-one editor tool.

Please report issues in this repository, not upstream. > > **The project is in public Beta.** The officially supported scope is the **trusted LAN**. When away from home, Tailscale is preferred (no server, direct connection); the relay (DLP/1) is a zero-config fallback and remains experimental. Plugins, the app, and the sync protocol iterate quickly, so before upgrading see [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/lunaship/dsh-cetus/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md) and the [compatibility matrix](https://github.com/lunaship/dsh-cetus/blob/HEAD/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md). ## Remote connection When the computer and phone are on the same Tailscale network, the pairing QR code automatically includes the Tailscale address. The phone first tries the primary LAN address, then this direct connection, and only falls back to the relay if both fail. You don't need to enter a `100.x` address yourself or set up a separate server. The relay is the zero-config fallback for when Tailscale isn't installed. Details are in [`REMOTE_ACCESS.md`](https://github.com/lunaship/dsh-cetus/blob/HEAD/REMOTE_ACCESS.md). --- ## Push gateway (DLPUSH/1) iOS doesn't allow a persistent SSE connection in the background, so once the phone leaves the App there is no connection; the push gateway fills this gap. sx120609/CPU-web.body:
# CPU-web

药大拾间 is a campus information aggregation site for students of China Pharmaceutical University. The current repository is no longer just a web MVP. It is a complete multi-platform project that includes:

- `web/`: Vue 3 frontend site and `/schedule` PWA timetable page
- `server/`: Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL backend
- `voicehub/`: 药苑之声 Nuxt full-stack sub-application (fully retains the VoiceHub song-request system)
- `android/`: Android WebView shell and desktop timetable widget
- `harmony/`: HarmonyOS WebView shell and JS Bridge
- `desktop/`: Windows / Apple Silicon macOS desktop app (Electron single-window tabbed app, OAuth2 login, automatic campus network connection, and 学习通 tab)

Repository: [https://github.com/sx120609/CPU-web](https://github.com/sx120609/CPU-web)

To get a less technical overview of the whole project, you can read [《药大拾间完整技术路线》](https://github.com/sx120609/CPU-web/blob/HEAD/docs/technical-overview.md) (Complete Technical Roadmap of 药大拾间), or download the [typeset PDF version](https://github.com/sx120609/CPU-web/blob/HEAD/output/pdf/yaoda-shijian-complete-technical-route.pdf) directly.

> Notes
>
> - This project is a student-run aggregation site. It is not an official platform of China Pharmaceutical University.
> - Campus unified authentication is used only to fetch academic data after the user authorizes it. The project does not store school passwords or verification codes.
> - The second-hand feature is a forum board for information exchange. This site does not provide in-site ordering, payment, escrow, refunds, or settlement.

## Current Capabilities

yuluo688/credit-manager.description: Quota, billing, concurrency and API key management plugin for CLIProxyAPI.
yuluo688/credit-manager.body:
# CPA Credit Manager

[English](https://github.com/yuluo688/credit-manager/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) | [Project repository](https://github.com/yuluo688/credit-manager) | [Download latest release](https://github.com/yuluo688/credit-manager/releases/latest)

`credit-manager` is a native Go plugin for [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI). It places plugin key authentication, quota pre-reservation, actual usage settlement, and usage analytics on the same request path, making it suitable for issuing independent, billable model access keys to teams, users, or automation tasks.

| Plugin ID | Runtime form |
|---|---|
| `credit-manager` | CGO `c-shared` dynamic library |

## What problem it solves

The host's upstream authentication, front-end `api-keys`, and usage callbacks may not reliably associate with the same caller under high concurrency. This plugin binds identity, pre-reservation, and settlement to the same `tk-...` key:

- Configure each key separately: total, daily, weekly, and monthly spending quotas, maximum concurrency, model access scope, and expiration time.
- Strictly pre-reserve quota based on conservative estimates before forwarding a request; reject directly when quota or concurrency is insufficient, so over-limit requests never reach upstream.
- Settle text tokens based on actual upstream usage; pure image generation is settled per image. Pricing supports model rules, context tiers, and `service_tier` tiers.
- Provides an admin console, management API, auditing, and usage statistics. Key holders can also query their own quota and details on a separate page.
- Aggregates upstream quota windows for Codex, Claude, Antigravity, Kimi, and xAI OAuth authentication, and can limit maximum concurrency per authentication.

> After enabling, the plugin takes over front-end authentication for model proxy requests. The original CLIProxyAPI `api-keys` can no longer be used for model calls; clients must send the complete issued `tk-...` key.

```text
Authorization: Bearer tk-...
```

`GET /v1/models` and `GET /v1beta/models` can anonymously fetch the public model catalog to remain compatible with the host management center; they cannot invoke models. Globally disabled models are removed from the catalog, but a key's model allowlist does not trim the public catalog.
